goal: Prove one portable V10 decision identity across Chief AI, PromptOS, and FCR.
customerOutcome: One decision can cross three peer repositories without semantic or authority drift.
desiredState: Chief creates one deterministic identity, PromptOS preserves it, and FCR independently verifies it.
currentState: Each repository implements its side of the V10 boundary but needs one shared conformance artifact.
bottleneck: Cross-repo compatibility is inferred until all three repositories agree on the same receipt identity.

verified: PromptOS preserves the submitted decision identity.
inferred: A shared fixture should detect future contract drift.
unknown: Long-run cross-repo drift rate is not measured yet.
